I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261 seats. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14.

- **Older figure:** I also pointed out that the 185 in that channel from August 2025 was the count under Amendment No. 1, not the renewal.
- **Not confirmed as final:** nothing posted in #north-team since Oct 14 changes the 261, but no one there has called it settled either. I suggested Dana check with Ilse before putting it in the tracker. I only read #north-team, which Dana is in, and didn't open any of the shared files.

A seat count isn't a finance figure and Dana is on the North team, so no approval was needed.
